Quin is a friendly labrador retriever who received his training through Paws for a Purpose. He accompanies handler Meghan Wnorowski-Bogle on a daily basis to provide comfort, calming and a few smiles to clients during her counseling sessions. Quin loves people, a good head rub and maybe one-too-many milk bones. He joined Wayne Corporation in 2024.
